newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$2.7 billion bonds due 2001.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$2.7 billion bonds due 2001.

text.p: The Government of Canada said it plans to auction on November 20 C$2.7 billion of bonds with a coupon of 7.00 percent and maturing on September 1, 2001.
The Bank of Canada said it will buy C$405 million of the new bonds.
The bonds, which will be dated and delivered on December 2, pay interest on March 1 and September 1. The new bonds are in addition to C$7.9 billion of bonds due September 2001 already outstanding.
Proceeds will be used for the general purposes of the Government of Canada, the bank said.
